Rock cannon are big lumps of rock with small holes drilled into them. And in the 19th century,
if there was something to be celebrated in a mining town round here,
locals would light fireworks, bonfires, and also fire rock cannon.

There are more than 200 rock cannon around Wales and they were used for all sorts of events.
